answer: Make every identity post a bond that vests slowly and is forfeited in full when a honeypot or audit catches it grading junk as genuine. Spinning up a fake is no longer free: each one ties up real capital on a thread that snaps the moment it misbehaves. Mass-minting sybils becomes a game of risking value, not smearing cheap pigment across a hundred hollow shells. Honest participants, pale and plain as ivory, keep their bond and compound while cheaters lose everything outright.
